Are you folks the tribe that live on land?\nIt's rare to see you here. Various things seem to\nbe happening lately and it's quite disturbing.
Oh, this is the first time I've seen someone who's\nnot a dragon or a Eumano.
By the way, is it true that the appearance of the\nEumanos has changed? The children keep saying that\nthey wanna see it, you know.
Oh! You are different from us!\nHey, where do you come from?
I'm the fastest swimmer of all the young Ranas!\nLet's have a competition later, okay?!
...Ah, I-I'm sorry. I couldn't help but stare at\nyou because...It's very rare to see someone of a\ndifferent tribe here.
What? You think I look more unusual?\nI-I bet you think so, hahaha.
[ffff64]Aquacity[ffffff]
I...I thought you were twins...
C-can someone please explain this?
The Ranas are a tribe with almost no individual\ndistinctions. Also, there are hardly any visible\ndifferences between a male Rana and female Rana...
Oh, Miss Mare! My apologies for not recognizing\nyou sooner. You have been an excellent warrior\ncommander.
It's fine, and thanks!\nI brought some guests, please be nice to them if\nyou see them.
Certainly.
Before heading to the council, let me show you\naround the town. Follow me...
Hey, you're Mare, right...? The townsmen respect\nyou so much. Does that mean you're a very\nhigh-ranking Rana? Like a king maybe...?
Come on, you can't be serious!\nI'm just one of the warriors who protects this\nAquacity.
And I'm so grateful that the they respect us\neven though we're just protecting the town...\nAlright, this way!
Hey, why is it glowing over there?
There's a place called the Little Shrine of Grace\nin there. It keeps the water temperature and\nenvironment stable.
Whoa, there are so many unusual things here~.
Feel free to ask if you have any more questions.\nI'll try my best to answer them.
Tell me about Rana again.
Tell me about Aqua Gota.
Tell me about your enemies.
I'm all good, thanks!
It's kinda hard to explain about ourselves.\nThe Eumanos are called the "Forest Inhabitants",\nwhile the Ranas are called the "Water Tribe".
How should I put it...? I'd say we're amphibians\nwho live both on land and in water.
As I said before, we're prolly unique due to the\nabsence of individual distinctions appearance-\nwise. But of course we can tell one another apart.
Hmm, well...It'd be a problem if you can't tell\none another apart either despite belonging to the\nsame tribe.
I think we need to remember your names and\ncharacteristics as we don't want to make mistakes\nand end up offending you...
It's the colossal drop of water we Ranas live in\nthat is floating in the sky of Toram. Our town,\nAquacity, is also in it.
It is said to have existed since Toram was formed,\nbut our ancestors moved in a little later.
There's a powerful surface tension on the outside\nto block intruders, but the increase in the number\nof intruders recently has been bothering us...
Those who can break through that strong repulsive\nforce must be quite something. We need to be\nreally careful...
We don't go out of Aqua Gota that much, so we\nrarely come into conflict with other factions.
The Coenubias invading this world hate water too,\nso we didn't really get a chance to confront them.
But since the collision between Toram and another\nworld happened, the dragons from that world have\nrepeatedly invaded our home.
Moreover, there have been sightings of Coenubias\naround Aqua Gota recently and the situation here\nhas become increasingly unpredictable.
Coenubias didn't invade this place because there's\na lot of water here. I see...
But hey, there are Coenubias that are resistant to\nwater now, so you guys should be careful!
We've heard about it and there have also been a\nfew reports about their intrusion. We're actually\ntrying to find a way to deal with that too.
We would like to ask the Ranas to join forces with\nthe Eumanos to fight against Coenubias.\nCould you please take us to your leader?
We don't really have a leader. We have a council\nmade up of a few councilors in charge of\nlegislative and administrative matters instead.
Please take us to the Parliament Hall then...
M-Miss Mare...
No problem. This way...
Don't pretend you care about Miss Mare. You never\nsaid no to the council's decision and sent her to\na dangerous place...You don't deserve to see her!!
Hey, please treat Mare and the others...\nMe? I've got something to do.\nI'm counting on you~!
Mera, wait~!
You're stuck in a tight spot, aren't you?
...To begin with, the relationship between the\ncouncils and the warriors isn't good...I became a\ncouncilor to serve as a bridge for them...
But, Mare doesn't seem to understand that...She\nconstantly worries me by acting recklessly as a\nwarrior, almost as if it's intentional...
That sets her apart from the others and leaves an\nimpression on the council. It's a good thing, but\nI also feel like she's being taken advantage of...
But as a member of the council too, it seems that\nyou're assigning dangerous tasks to Mare, though?
Because if I don't do so, they'll say that I'm\ntaking the warrior's side because I'm also someone\nfrom a warrior family.
Then I won't be able to voice my opinion to the\ncouncil any more as they'll think that I can't be\nobjective...
Hm~, it's kinda stupid but also makes sense at the\nsame time. It's complicated...
It seems that Mare is back once again.\nI heard she's slightly injured this time though...
She's extremely lucky! I don't understand why\nwe're still assigning tasks to her!
Well, as Mare keeps accomplishing the missions\ngiven to her, the other warriors will grow jealous\nand it will weaken their solidarity.
Even if she fails a mission and dies, we can just\nhold a grand memorial service. The warriors will\nbe touched and we'll be able to win them over.
Either way, it's good for us!
Heyyy!!
Mare and Aga are risking their lives to carry out\ntheir tasks for the Ranas, you know...You think\nthat their lives are worthless?!
Ooh!!
It's shaking, what in the world is causing it?!
Don't tell me...The Little Shrine of Grace?!
Aga, let's go to the Little Shrine of Grace!
Wait! Assigning tasks only to you was apparently\npart of the council's plan all this time.\nYou don't need to sacrifice yourself anymore!!
I didn't agree to do those risky tasks because the\ncouncil ordered me to, but I did them to protect\nthe Ranas. I'm willing to risk my life for it!
Whoa...What I blurted out in anger turns out to be\nright...
Pelulu!
Here...I'll leave Mare and the others to you.
The Entry Permit for the Little Shrine of Grace\nhas been obtained!
We'll take Mare and the others home safely!\nJust leave them to us!
Oh, Miss Mare, you came at the right time!\nMiss Mera, Miss Mera is...!!
Whaat?!
